C0956.title: Chengdu Police Report Staged Blind-Date Videos: Six Detained for Fabricating Identities
C0956.summary: On March 13, 2025, police in Wuhou District, Chengdu, reported that widely shared blind-date videos had been staged. The same man appeared in the same setting while giving different job, residence, and income claims, including claims of working at a government agency and earning RMB 350,000 to 400,000 a year. Police detained six people, illustrating how staged accounts use fabricated identities to manufacture traffic.
